notes.title: Release date postponed due to new features
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! :-)

As the game was ready to be released in May 2023, the newly beta testing reports came in and players agree that the main campaign is too hard. That is a funny thing, as I reworked the campaign once already to make it HARDER as it seemed too easy to me... So, in order to make game more user-friendly, campaign will have to be reworked again and it will probably take a couple of months or so. I am still deciding on how to approach it: to make user select the difficulty, or to make a separate, tutorial campaign with lower difficulty, or simply make the current campaign generally easier (by making bots react slower, and similar). We'll see. Some GUI modifications will be introduced as well as the main menu seems confussing to some players (noone chooses to play tutorial first, and when players start the campaign, they are unsure what to do).

So, the release date has been change to a more generic date: "2023". Hopefully implementing the required changes won't take more than a couple of months.

In the meantime, [u][b]anyone can download the full game and play it freely[/b][/u] by joining the Testplay! And providing feedback, of course, which is very much appreciated.

Thank you :-)
